Ngoại hình lấy từ ẢNH THẬT người dùng cung cấp 2026-08-03 (áo phao đỏ, tóc ngắn, đeo khẩu trang) — giữ nguyên, KHÔNG đổi. ⚠️ HỆ QUẢ PHẢI NHỚ KHI VIẾT CẢNH: khẩu trang che miệng nên MẮT gánh toàn bộ biểu cảm. assets.name: Long Wang Village Day
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day in 2020, seen straight on like a theatre backdrop. The picture is built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: FIRST a plain pale grey-white overcast sky band across the top with no clouds and no birds; SECOND a row of EXACTLY THREE small single-storey village houses and no more, standing side by side in ONE straight row, each seen straight from the front with its front wall ONE single flat shape of pale grey stone and NO side wall visible at all, each under ONE single simple triangular dark grey tile roof, all three roofs at exactly the same height. The row of houses is scaled up so that it completely fills the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge with absolutely NO gap of open sky, grass or ground left at either side. Each house has EXACTLY ONE plain door and EXACTLY ONE plain square window and no more. THIRD a narrow strip of plain flat green grass running edge to edge along the foot of the houses; and FOURTH, filling the whole bottom third of the frame nearest the viewer, one wide plain flat tan dirt path running edge to edge, left completely clear and empty so that people can stand and walk on it. The houses stand ON the grass strip and must touch it, not float. Every roofline and every band runs perfectly horizontally, unbroken from the left edge to the right edge; nothing is drawn at an angle, nothing narrows toward a distance and there is no vanishing point anywhere. Nothing stands behind the houses at all — no second row of buildings and no distant rooftops. Draw NO wood grain, NO plank lines, NO brick courses, NO roof tiles drawn one by one and NO texture of any kind. Every sign, board and notice is left completely BLANK — absolutely no writing, no letters, no characters and no numbers anywhere in the picture. There are no people, no animals, no vehicles, no poles and no wires anywhere. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber, green and pale earth tones in a few flat tints. Plain flat overcast daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: Bản gen-1 xếp dải là nhà → ĐƯỜNG ĐẤT → cỏ ở đáy, tức A Fei đi trên đường mà đường lại không phải dải dưới cùng — đúng lỗi đã trả giá ở case 5 ('Kinmen Shore Daytime', skill mục 6a: hỏi NHÂN VẬT ĐỨNG TRÊN CÁI GÌ, cái đó bắt buộc là dải DƯỚI CÙNG). Đã đảo thành cỏ → đường ở đáy. Thêm: ra số nhà (EXACTLY THREE), cấm chữ trên biển hiệu (mục 6i — làng Trung Quốc chắc chắn sinh biển chữ Hán bậy), cấm vân bề mặt, cấm người.
